text:
maya: quick FYI 1: deploybot flagged increased p95 on canary after v3.5.0. autopilot suppressed due to metric noise. can someone take lead?

devon: looking now. generator path p95 +230ms, embeddings stable. canary 7% in usw2. no obvious errors in logs.

ops-bot: snapshot: canary_slice=7% p95_delta=+230ms error_rate=1.2% baseline_error=0.6% host_spread=3/5

ryan: i'd prefer manual revert path. we should require operator handshake to prevent overlap with any auto actions. propose criteria: sustained >200ms for 5m + operator ack.

maya: agreed. put criteria in thread: (1) p95 delta >200ms sustained 5m; (2) infra checks green (no node restarts); (3) operator handshake present; (4) comms owner assigned.

sasha: i'll take comms. draft to support: "We temporarily rolled back the recent canary to the previous stable version due to a latency regression detected in a canary slice. Traffic restored to v3.4.1 and were investigating. No impact to persisted data." will send once revert confirmed.

devon: quick triage points at attention-kernel heuristics under long-context. reproduces on staging with similar requests. ops: do you want a kernel-flag revert or full version revert?

ryan: full version revert for speed and safety. command we'll use: `/deploy revert --to v3.4.1 --reason "canary latency regression" --operator ryan`

maya: operator handshake: @ryan do you confirm? @sasha prep comms. devon standby for follow-up patch notes.

ryan: confirm. executing in 20s. will annotate release ticket.

deploybot: Request received: revert to v3.4.1. Running prechecks...

deploybot: Prechecks OK 1: artifact v3.4.1 verified, migrations none, rollout plan ready. Initiating revert: canary -> rollback -> graceful drain of v3.5.0.

ryan: executed `/deploy revert --to v3.4.1 --reason "canary latency regression" --operator ryan` 1: acknowledged.

deploybot: Revert underway: canary slice removed, rolling back to v3.4.1 across canary pool. ETA ~3m.

sasha: sending comms to #customer-success now. draft included changelog line: "reverted to v3.4.1 to address a latency regression observed in canary".

deploybot: Revert complete: active=v3.4.1 inactive=v3.5.0 canary=0%

devon: verified p95 returned to baseline ~90s after revert. opened issue (REL-5482) to track attention-kernel regression and targeted patch plan.

ryan: left note in release ticket and flagged for testing with long-context suites before next roll.

maya: good work. post-rollback checklist: ops monitor 24h, devon+ryan own root cause, sasha finalize external comms and update release notes. thanks all :thumbsup:
